connector.none: no captured Jina connector; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.1 GET r.jina.ai/<page URL> with an httpHeaderAuth credential (Authorization: Bearer); Jina Reader answers text/plain markdown (Title, URL Source, Markdown Content), which the node puts in $json.data

connector.none: no captured Google Sheets connector for writes

writeReplies.note: Sheets v4.2 append, autoMapInputData, gid 258629074: sheet properties (gid → Sheet2), GET values/'Sheet2' (header + existing rows), the extractor's keys title/product_url/image_url are not columns, so n8n writes the widened header to Sheet2!1:1 (insertInNewColumn, the default), adds a row (batchUpdate appendDimension), then PUTs the rows from row 2. The row count is model-driven; the PUT range assumes 2 books, and any other range gets the mock's write default

branches: the rows appended are what the extractor returns (model-driven); the only write target stays Sheet2 of Book Prices
expect.offline: The page is books.toscrape.com as Jina Reader renders it; the extraction (how many books, which fields) is model-driven, so the append rows follow the recorded reply. allowUnauthorizedCerts is set on Jina Fetch
